name: Structure Packs
description: These mods add buildings to the Overworld and beyond.

pages.title: Structure Packs
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() No setup: walk, ride or fly and you will find them.
- Most chests follow [#](2E5AAC)[Lootr](entry://exploration/lootr)[#]()'s per-player loot rules.
- Four families: **Towns and Towers**, **Dungeons and Taverns**, **When Dungeons Arise** and **YUNG's**.
These mods add buildings to the Overworld and beyond. They need no setup: walk, ride or fly and you will find them. Most have chests that follow Lootr's per-player loot rules.
**Towns and Towers** adds many new village styles, pillager outposts, a wandering trader camp and ships, as variants for different biomes.
**Dungeons and Taverns** adds hamlets, taverns for every wood, wells, crypts, shrines, firewatch towers and Nether and End builds: Nether keeps and ports, End castles, ships and lighthouses.

**When Dungeons Arise** adds big roguelike builds: coliseum, aviary, bandit towers, foundry, illager forts, monasteries, shiraz palace, plague asylum, typhon, thornborn towers and a mechanical nest. Several have bosses.
**YUNG's** series reworks vanilla structures: Better Dungeons, Mineshafts, Strongholds, Desert Temples, Jungle Temples, Witch Huts and Ocean Monuments. Same places, much better builds and loot.

pages.title: Dungeon Loot
pages.text: The chests in these builds are the reason to visit. Lootr makes them per-player.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** Some underground structures are spaced wider than their mods default: YUNG's small dungeons, Alex's Caves' underground cabins, and Dungeons and Taverns' underground houses and deepslate camps. The pack still has many more structures than vanilla.
